descriptionChirho: The proper noun Rimmon, a place name referring to locations in the tribal territories of Israel (Simeon, Zebulun, Benjamin). The variant 'Rimmono' (S136045) in 1 Chronicles 6:77 is an alternate spelling of the same place. All clusters are purely grammatical variants with prepositions (to-Rimmon, and-Rimmon) or articles (the-Rimmon). English 'Rimmon/Rimmono', Spanish 'Rimon/Rimono', Hindi 'Rimmon/Rimmono', Arabic 'ar-Rimman/Rimmuno', Korean variations of 'Rimmon', Swahili 'Rimoni/Rimono' -- all identify the same geographic proper noun.
